description: A default object value gets the defaults of its own optional attributes
notes: The README says defaults populate missing optional attributes, and Defaults.Apply's documentation says it applies defaults wherever optional attributes are missing in the given value, without saying whether a default value it inserts gets the defaults of its own attributes. hashicorp/hcl converts each default value to its attribute's type when it reads the type (getType in ext/typeexpr/get_type.go), which turns {} into {b = null}, and Defaults.apply (ext/typeexpr/defaults.go) applies the attribute's child defaults to that value, where b gets its default because a null attribute counts as missing (native/type-expressions/defaults-null-attribute).
